Home/Our story
Our story

Made in Penticton by a dog person, for dog people.

Boopdog started at a kitchen table with two dogs, Jax and Ruby, who went through gear faster than anything in the pet store could keep up with. So Trish started making her own from genuine Biothane® — waterproof, stink-proof and wipe-clean — and later added Beadworks, our beaded silicone collars.

[Placeholder copy — Trish to confirm the founding story, dates and wording.]

Shop the collectionBehind the seams
Photo: Trish with Jax & Ruby in the workshop · 4:5

What we stand for

Handmade, one at a time

Every leash and collar is cut, stitched and finished by hand in our Penticton workshop — never mass-produced.

Built for real weather

Biothane® and silicone that shrug off lake swims, mud and the Okanagan sun — and never get smelly.

Your dog, your choice

Dozens of colours, three hardware finishes and a custom builder, so the gear fits your dog and your style.

How a Boopdog leash gets made

CutBiothane® measured and cut to your chosen length.
FinishEdges finished and holes punched by hand.
HardwareBrass, nickel or black — riveted by hand.
Check & shipPull-tested, packed, and on its way from BC.

Help centre

Shipping & returns

[Placeholder policy — confirm rates, carriers and timelines with Trish before launch.]

DestinationRateDelivery
Canada — orders over $60Free2–7 business days
Canada — under $60$9 flat2–7 business days
United StatesFrom $145–10 business days

Processing time

In-stock items ship within 1–2 business days. Custom and made-to-order pieces are handmade after you order and ship within 5–7 business days. You'll get a tracking link by email the moment it leaves the workshop.

Returns

Changed your mind? Return unworn, unwashed items within 30 days of delivery for a refund or exchange. Custom builds are final sale — but if the size is wrong, talk to us and we'll make it right.

Exchanges for fit

Wrong size? We'll swap it for free on your first exchange. Use the size guide before ordering to get it right first time.

Something not right?

If anything arrives faulty, email us a photo within 30 days and we'll repair or replace it.
